attribution: Every case removes any stale output before launching its child and stats the output path after the child exits, so a leftover file cannot be attributed to a case and missing / zero-byte / partial outputs are distinguishable. --python-exit-code 1 makes an uncaught Python exception surface as a nonzero exit, so it is not silently filed as a native abort; crash_class stays neutral and exit_signature + stderr_tail + file state carry the concrete attribution.

blender_under_test.note: 4.5.13 LTS (daeeeca98fb0) is the version reported in the originating issue; 5.1.1 was the locally available build and is used to show the defects are still present in a later major release. Source analysis below is pinned to the exact 4.5.13 commit.

bounds: These are measurements, not a fix, not isolation, and not a listening/quality certification. No subjective/MP3 acceptance is claimed. The native encoder is not repaired by anything in this directory. A CRASH verdict records an abnormal termination, not proof of the output file's size; the per-case file_exists / output_bytes / output_state fields are the authoritative output-file evidence.

fields.crash_class: Neutral classification of a run that produced no usable result: no_result_exit_0 (likely a script-level exception), no_result_nonzero_exit (abnormal termination, e.g. a native fast-fail), bad_result_json (marker printed but JSON unparseable), timeout. null for runs with a valid result.
fields.file_bytes: Output size measured by the reproducer; null when it printed no result.
fields.file_exists: Whether the output path existed after the child exited (post-run stat, all cases).
fields.output_bytes: Authoritative post-run size of the output path in bytes; null when missing (all cases).
fields.output_state: missing | zero_byte | nonzero, derived from file_exists / output_bytes.
fields.stderr_tail: Last 400 chars of child stderr (every case).
fields.stdout_tail: Last 400 chars of child stdout (every case).

formulas.surplus_is: the final FFMPEGWriter::write() chunk, encoded a second time by ~FFMPEGWriter
formulas.surplus_samples: requested % accuracy, or accuracy when requested % accuracy == 0

harness.decoder: dependency-free RIFF/WAVE chunk walker (no numpy / no external decoder)
harness.method: one Blender background subprocess per case; empty scene mixes down to silence

purpose: Standalone, MCP-free reproduction of native Blender bpy.ops.sound.mixdown PCM surplus and accuracy-dependent ffmpeg abort.
